name: Cardiology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the heart and blood vessels.

name: Cardiothoracic Surgery
description: Surgery of the heart, lungs and other organs in the chest.

name: Dentistry
description: Care of the teeth, gums and mouth.

name: Dermatology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the skin, hair and nails.

name: Endocrinology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with hormones and the glands that produce them, including diabetes and thyroid conditions.

name: ENT (Otolaryngology)
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the ear, nose and throat.

name: Gastroenterology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the digestive system, including the stomach, intestines and liver.

name: General Practice
description: Primary, general medical care for people of all ages.

name: General Surgery
description: Surgery covering a broad range of conditions, commonly of the abdomen.

name: Gynaecology & Obstetrics
description: The branches of medicine concerned with women's reproductive health, pregnancy and childbirth.

name: Internal Medicine
description: The diagnosis and non-surgical care of conditions affecting adults' internal organs.

name: Nephrology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the kidneys.

name: Neurology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the brain, spinal cord and nerves.

name: Neurosurgery
description: Surgery of the brain, spine and nervous system.

name: Oncology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with cancer.

name: Ophthalmology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the eyes and vision.

name: Orthopaedics
description: The branch of medicine concerned with bones, joints, ligaments and muscles.

name: Paediatrics
description: Medical care of babies, children and adolescents.

name: Psychiatry
description: The branch of medicine concerned with mental health.

name: Pulmonology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the lungs and breathing.

name: Radiology
description: Medical imaging such as X-ray, ultrasound, CT and MRI.

name: Urology
description: The branch of medicine concerned with the urinary system and male reproductive organs.
